fit.gap_handling_summary: The CV presents credible adjacent experience without relabelling the candidate as an established ML engineer. It carefully distinguishes the personal CNN course project from professional work and credits deployment to the platform team. However, assistant/RAG, large-text processing, serving, monitoring, CI/CD and LLM experience remain unaddressed; the letter also stretches the documented data-scientist tenure into a specific duration of operationalisation experience.

issues: Two pages are acceptable for this seniority, but the second page is only 16.1% filled.
The technical-skills section breaks across pages, including a split skills line.
The profile is relatively long and could be shortened to improve pagination.

reasons: The PDF extracts in sensible order, with intact words and standard section headings.
Data pipelines and model evaluation are represented semantically by scheduled workflows, dbt, WAPE and holdout validation rather than those exact labels.
Python, GCP and feature engineering are well evidenced.
The CV does not establish the required four years as an ML engineer shipping production systems.
Most customer-support AI, LLM and production-MLOps keywords are absent because the supplied material does not establish those capabilities.

issues: The opening converts over four years as a data scientist into over four years developing and operationalising Python models and scheduled GCP workflows; that specific duration is not established.
Most of the letter repeats CV achievements, and the final paragraph repeats the cloud/data-tool inventory.
Company specificity is limited to the advertised merchant-support mission rather than distinctive company information.
It does not clearly frame the move from forecasting and analytics into customer-support AI or acknowledge the lack of assistant/RAG experience.
strengths: Names the correct employer and exact role.
Uses relevant, quantified evidence rather than unsupported AI-product claims.
Preserves the estimated nature of the food-waste result.
Explicitly credits the platform team for Cloud Run deployment.
Professional, readable English and an appropriate one-page length.

spacing_issues: The CV's second page is only 16.1% filled, leaving almost the entire page empty.

The first CV page is dense while the second contains only the end of technical skills and languages.
issues: The skills section needs controlled pagination or tighter editing; the current spillover looks unfinished.

fluency_and_tone_issues: 'feature engineering for calendar, price and menu-position features' is repetitive; 'engineered calendar, price and menu-position features' is cleaner.

'connect model development with scheduled data workflows, operational reporting, experimentation decisions and cross-team adoption, while working across teams' is abstract and repeats the cross-team idea.
